candidats.titre: File:1956 Hudson Rambler sedan Hershey 2012 b.jpg
candidats.description: 1956 Hudson Rambler 4-door sedan, "Custom" trim model - built by the American Motors Corporation (AMC). Rear right side view. This four-door sedan features the popular "continental" spare tire mount and a pink and white two-tone exterior finish, as well as the factory "Weather Eye" heating and air conditioning system. It has the "airliner" individually adjustable and reclining front seats that can be used as a bed. The dealer accessory window insect screens as also installed on the car's right side. The "compact" 108-inch wheelbase Rambler line was marketed by both Hudson and Nash dealerships

candidats.titre: File:A girl collecting mosquito nets for her family, DR Congo, October 2012 (8406177038).jpg
candidats.description: A girl in South Ubangi in Equateur Province, DRC, receiving mosquito nets as part of a UK-funded distribution programme. Equateur is one of the most remote places in the world, straddling the Congo river and in middle of the world’s second largest rainforest. This is the first time every person in Equateur will be able to sleep under a bed net, which will help protect people against malaria.

candidats.titre: File:Brief Moments of Being a Child.jpg
candidats.description: I spent three months living with Michael and his family in a rural village in southwest Benin. During the three months of documenting my stay, this was the only moment I saw Michael, in the home, being a kid. Apart from school, he spent his time collecting water from the village pump, helping cook meals, doing his laundry, and finding time to complete his homework.
